items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Clear Go-style names, doc comments on the new exported Encode/Decode, gofmt applied. Business logic uses terse single-letter names (`n := d.readUvarint()`, `pts`, `cv`), and the large ShapeIndex encode/decode block in shapeindex.go has little explanation of its wire layout.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the sticky encoder/decoder helpers, but ShapeIndex.Encode/Decode went into shapeindex.go (+504 lines) instead of a dedicated shapeindex_encode.go. The X/Y/Z read loop is copy-pasted across 4 shapes, and the Decode span (about L1602-1904) looks monolithic. Unrelated fixes were bundled in (crossing_edge_query, ChainEdge).

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Every length is bounded before allocating (maxEncodedVertices/Loops/shapes/cells). Cumulative vertex counts are checked for order and endpoints, shape/edge IDs are range-checked, and Polyline.decode now takes `*decoder` so errors propagate. decodeFaceRun is bounded. Includes truncation, bit-flip and fuzz tests.

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: typeTag values are unchanged and no tags were renumbered (LaxLoop/Loop stay typeTagNone and use the generic fallback). The Shape interface is unchanged. Polyline/Polygon wire formats are the same: only `decoder` became `*decoder` and early returns were added. Lax/PointVector Encode/Decode are new additive methods.
